_doc: Dungeon maps (Systems/Dungeons.cs). Every site's delve is a map drawn once from its own dice: a main way of rooms (its deck, 2 + tier of them as before) to the heart, side rooms off it (sideRooms by tier, from the rest of the deck or caches of the hoard's gold), and a feature in some rooms. Cleared rooms stay cleared between trips; the occupants react to the time between (reactions by site kind). Companies choose an approach at the door (approaches). Clearing a site of tier deeps.minTier or more may open its deeps: a new site a tier harder below it, with a sure find in its hoard.

checks._doc: Delve checks: a new site's trap and hazard DC is dc plus half its level. The hero who rolls has advantage when their class training (classes.json skills) is specialist or more, disadvantage when it is untrained or less, so a party with the right hero for the room does far better. harder adds to a room's own DC by kind.

features.name: pitch dark
features.text: the lanterns barely reach the walls
features.answer: {name}'s eyes find the way in the dark

features.name: chasm
features.answer: {name} gets a line across the chasm

features.name: narrow

features.answer: {name} slips ahead and holds the far end

features.text: webs hang thick from the ceiling

features.answer: {name} speaks a blessing and the cold lifts

features.name: rubble

features.answer: {name} finds a way round the fall

reactions._doc: What the occupants do between trips, by site kind: everyDays per reaction (at most max), chosen by weight. regroup retakes the cleared room nearest the heart; traps sets a trap in a cleared room; allies brings more foes to every fight (swell); hoard hides the hoard deeper (a perception check at the heart, or only part of the gold).

texts.regroup: {they} have taken back {room} since the last company came.
texts.traps: {they} have strung a new trap across {room}.
texts.allies: {they} have called in friends: there are more of them now.
texts.hoard: {they} have moved the hoard somewhere deeper.

approaches._doc: How a company goes in, chosen at the door by weight plus up to noise: storm (fight room by room), sneak (the heist's slip-past checks; rooms passed stay held), parley (talk the master down, as the talk-down terms), siege (camp outside days, thinning every fight by swell, with a sally each night). A mapped place (scouted, or a company came home from it) adds mapped to sneak and siege. Weaker parties lean on underdog per level they are short. The party's make-up adds class when it has a hero of one of classes, and crowded when it is crowd heroes or more.

texts.storm: They go in the front way, weapons out.
texts.sneak: {name} leads them in by a back way, quiet as cats.
texts.parley: They go to the gate under a branch of truce.
texts.siege: They camp round {site} to starve it out before going in.

deeps._deeper: Names for a level below a level, of the top site's name, so no name doubles ("Lower Halls of Lower Halls").
deeps.found: Below {site}, the {party} find a stair going down into the dark. Something older lives there.
